capabilities: Arrange draggable, resizable widgets on a 12-column grid across multiple homepage tabs
Track habits, pomodoro sessions, countdowns, and anniversaries from dashboard cards
Turn markdown tasks into a drag-and-drop kanban board
Show vault statistics, recent notes, on-this-day notes, and embedded note sections
Write custom widgets as hot-reloaded JavaScript files in a vault folder
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Support community is a QQ group communicating mainly in Simplified Chinese. Several widgets (Duowei Table tasks, WeChat inbox, annotations) only work with companion plugins or synced data from outside apps.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in start page or dashboard, so users must open individual notes or views to see recent files, tasks, and vault statistics.

relations.evidence: Duowei Table (duowei-table-pro ≥ 1.4.0) registers duowei-view via the Host API.
Connects to Mobile Ink Annotation Pro to show inbox annotations, daily reviews, and collections.
Open-Meteo and QWeather only connect when explicitly selected and configured.

summary: Dashboard plugin that turns a homepage into a configurable grid of widgets: greeting banner, recent notes, pomodoro, habits, task kanban, and vault stats.
